destination_dir.description: The target directory for extraction or output.

password.description: Password to decrypt RAR archives. If empty, no password is used.

files_to_process.description: Specific files within the archive to process. If empty, all files are handled based on the action.

force_overwrite.description: If true, overwrite existing files when extracting (--force).

extract_newer.description: If true, only extract files that are newer than existing ones (--extract-newer).

extract_no_paths.description: If true, do not create directories while extracting (--extract-no-paths).

verbose.description: If true, list files verbosely (-v equivalent).

assume_yes.description: If true, assume yes on queries (-y). Note: ineffective in unrar-free.
